pages.text: Ember Grove, Sulfur Springs, Ember Meadow, Wartvine Tangle, Hellwood Jungle, Molten Glass Lake and vanilla biomes. A temple surrounded by a $(l)lava moat$(): cross the bridge and survive the Blaze altars of the courtyard. Inside, two ritual rooms (spawners, chests, mimics).
A great staircase $(l)goes down$() to the underground nave lit by lava, where the $(l)Infernal Warlock$() waits. The sealed vault opens in the north wall of the nave.
